_about: Pricing and offer research for the agency (read 2026-11-14 with web search; most price sources are vendor blogs, so they are ranges, not facts). The three packages themselves live in agency/config.json (the owner's prices); this file holds the market, the funnel assumptions and the sources. agency/money.py turns them into the plan to $5,000 a month.

market.value: 17% of US small businesses (83% have one)
market.source: Clutch, small-business website survey, press release 2025-08-21

market.value: top answer 'not relevant to my industry' (34%); cost is the main reason for only 16%
market.source: Clutch, Do I need a website for my business (2025 data)

market.what: Freelancer site for a small business
market.source: Seahawk Media and TDL Web Solutions pricing guides, 2025

market.what: Agency site for a small business

market.value: Wix Light $17, Core $29, Business $39 a month (annual); Squarespace from about $19 a month after its July 2026 increase
market.source: Website Builder Expert (Feb 2026) and Hostadvice (2026) price comparisons

market.value: basic $39 - $99 a month; typical $50 - $200 a month
market.source: Fatlab, Seahawk Media, WPX maintenance-package guides 2025-2026

market.value: 0.45% of emails sent (7.5 million emails, 2025) up to about 4-4.5% in friendlier samples
market.source: Belkins 2025 study; Hunter, The State of Cold Email 2025

market.value: about 6-10% of dials reach a person; 2.3-2.7% of conversations book a meeting
market.source: Belkins cold-calling benchmarks; Cognism cold calling report 2026

market.value: claimed 3-5x better than plain cold outreach and 20-50% closes on demos shown, but only anecdotes and vendor claims: no audited study
market.source: Kolonell 2026 field notes; dev.to build-then-pitch experiment

market.value: Google shut down every business.site website on 2024-03-01 (redirects ended 2024-06-10): those owners lost their site
about 42% of US page views (desktop about 56%), August 2026
market.source: Statcounter Global Stats, platform market share, United States

hosting.value: 300 credits a month; a production deploy costs 15 credits (about 20 deploys a month); forms are free and unlimited on credit plans; bandwidth 20 credits per GB; at zero credits every site pauses. Personal plan $9 a month = 1,000 credits
hosting.source: netlify.com/pricing and docs.netlify.com 'How credits work', read 2026-11-14

hosting.value: drag the site FOLDER onto app.netlify.com/drop (a zip must be unzipped first); new projects start private until you publish
drag and drop a zip or a folder (Workers & Pages > Create > Drag and drop); 500 builds a month on the Free plan
hosting.source: developers.cloudflare.com Pages Direct Upload (2026-04-21) and Limits (2026-09-05)

hosting.what: Google Places API (the paid lead source)
hosting.value: Nearby Search Pro: 5,000 free calls a month, then $32 per 1,000; the $200 monthly credit was replaced by per-SKU free caps in March 2025
hosting.source: Google Maps Platform pricing list, read via search 2026-11-14

rules.value: true From and subject, say it is an ad, your valid postal address, a working opt-out honoured within 10 business days (it must work for 30 days); up to $53,088 per bad email
rules.source: FTC, CAN-SPAM Act: A Compliance Guide for Business

assumptions._about: The funnel the money math uses. They are ESTIMATES for a phone-first, demo-first approach to owner-run local shops (higher reach than the corporate B2B benchmarks above). Replace them with your own numbers after 2 weeks: the Agency page counts them for you.
